finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
finding.summary: An unsanitized note-text field submitted to AnnotationsController flows through AnnotationService and AnnotationCacheClient into RedisWireWriter, which hand-builds a Redis inline-protocol SET command and writes it to the raw socket, letting embedded CRLF sequences inject additional Redis commands across this 4-file call chain.
